title: aep plan artifact spend input
description: Report spend per task kind and figure against the project's baseline and target.

kind.description: `--kind <k>`: only rows of that task kind.

since.description: `--since <date>`: only records whose `at` is at or after 00:00 UTC of that day.

baseline.description: `--baseline <n>`: each median over the first `n` artifacts of each kind.
